newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal cuts rates by 30 basis points.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal cuts rates by 30 basis points.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal cut 30 basis points off all its three official rates on Friday, surprising market analysts who had expected no change.
The Bank cut the repo rate to 5.7 percent from 6.0 and offered 50 billion escudos ($532 million) at a tender which will take effect on Monday. Bids must be received by 1415 GMT.
The drain, or absorption rate was cut to 5.4 from 5.7 percent, while the emergency lending rate dropped to 7.4 percent from 7.7 percent. ($ = 93.99 Cape Verde Escudos)
